Provider.source_text:
# Local JSON provider-mapping prototype. Open questions: DISPATCH.md.
domain provider-response "Provider response mapper"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner inference-router-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema Input:
  answer: string max 32768
  stop_reason: string pattern "^(stop|length|content_filter|unknown)$"
  prompt_tokens: integer optional nullable min 0 max 1000000000
  completion_tokens: integer optional nullable min 0 max 1000000000

schema Output:
  status: string const "mapped"
  text: string max 32768
  finish_reason: string pattern "^(stop|length|content_filter|unknown)$"
  input_tokens: integer optional nullable min 0 max 1000000000
  output_tokens: integer optional nullable min 0 max 1000000000

mapping ResultBody:
  meaning "Normalize fixture provider output and preserve missing token observations."
  target Output
  field status = "mapped"
  field text = input.answer
  field finish_reason = input.stop_reason
  field input_tokens = input.prompt_tokens
  field output_tokens = input.completion_tokens

result Map:
  when true yield ResultBody

endpoint Mapper:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/internal/provider-response"
  input Input
  output Output
  result Map
  auth-env INFERENCE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  max-bytes 65536
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status mapped 200

Public.source_text:
# Open questions: invocation/PLAN.md.
domain invocation-completion "invocation-completion"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner inference-router-owner
logic sfol-v1
import Provider from "./provider-response.alch"
import Public from "./service/inference-result.alch"
schema Input:
  request_id: identifier max 128
  model: identifier max 128
  result: Provider.Output
schema Output:
  status: string const "ok"
  value: Public.Input
mapping Text:
  meaning "Expose normalized provider text."
  target Public.Text
  field text = input.result.text
mapping InputReported:
  meaning "Preserve input_tokens observation provenance."
  target Public.Observation
  field value = input.result.input_tokens
  field provenance = "provider-reported"
mapping InputUnavailable:
  meaning "Preserve input_tokens observation provenance."
  target Public.Observation
  field value = null
  field provenance = "unavailable"
mapping OutputReported:
  meaning "Preserve output_tokens observation provenance."
  target Public.Observation
  field value = input.result.output_tokens
  field provenance = "provider-reported"
mapping OutputUnavailable:
  meaning "Preserve output_tokens observation provenance."
  target Public.Observation
  field value = null
  field provenance = "unavailable"
mapping UsageReportedReported:
  meaning "Carry both independent token observations."
  target Public.Usage
  field input_tokens = InputReported
  field output_tokens = OutputReported
mapping BodyReportedReported:
  meaning "Form the public completion using pinned identity."
  target Public.Input
  field request_id = input.request_id
  field model = input.model
  field output = Text
  field finish_reason = input.result.finish_reason
  field usage = UsageReportedReported
mapping WrappedReportedReported:
  meaning "Return the public completion."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field value = BodyReportedReported
mapping UsageReportedUnavailable:
  meaning "Carry both independent token observations."
  target Public.Usage
  field input_tokens = InputReported
  field output_tokens = OutputUnavailable
mapping BodyReportedUnavailable:
  meaning "Form the public completion using pinned identity."
  target Public.Input
  field request_id = input.request_id
  field model = input.model
  field output = Text
  field finish_reason = input.result.finish_reason
  field usage = UsageReportedUnavailable
mapping WrappedReportedUnavailable:
  meaning "Return the public completion."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field value = BodyReportedUnavailable
mapping UsageUnavailableReported:
  meaning "Carry both independent token observations."
  target Public.Usage
  field input_tokens = InputUnavailable
  field output_tokens = OutputReported
mapping BodyUnavailableReported:
  meaning "Form the public completion using pinned identity."
  target Public.Input
  field request_id = input.request_id
  field model = input.model
  field output = Text
  field finish_reason = input.result.finish_reason
  field usage = UsageUnavailableReported
mapping WrappedUnavailableReported:
  meaning "Return the public completion."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field value = BodyUnavailableReported
mapping UsageUnavailableUnavailable:
  meaning "Carry both independent token observations."
  target Public.Usage
  field input_tokens = InputUnavailable
  field output_tokens = OutputUnavailable
mapping BodyUnavailableUnavailable:
  meaning "Form the public completion using pinned identity."
  target Public.Input
  field request_id = input.request_id
  field model = input.model
  field output = Text
  field finish_reason = input.result.finish_reason
  field usage = UsageUnavailableUnavailable
mapping WrappedUnavailableUnavailable:
  meaning "Return the public completion."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field value = BodyUnavailableUnavailable
result Result:
  when present(input.result.input_tokens) and present(input.result.output_tokens) yield WrappedReportedReported
  when present(input.result.input_tokens) and not present(input.result.output_tokens) yield WrappedReportedUnavailable
  when not present(input.result.input_tokens) and present(input.result.output_tokens) yield WrappedUnavailableReported
  when not present(input.result.input_tokens) and not present(input.result.output_tokens) yield WrappedUnavailableUnavailable

endpoint Function:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/internal/invocation-completion"
  input Input
  output Output
  result Result
  auth-env INFERENCE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  max-bytes 262144
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status ok 200
